original_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original adult character portrait for a cohesive premium 3D romance-game character collection. Polished 2.5D/3D sculpted digital character, unmistakably high-end CG, refined attractive facial modeling, anatomically elegant proportions, expressive eyes only subtly enlarged, detailed groomed individual hair strands, soft realistic subsurface scattering with restrained skin microtexture and low sheen, dimensional fabric and metals. Not a live-action photograph, not flat anime, not a doll or plastic toy. All characters aged 22-28. Clean opaque pure white #FFFFFF seamless background with no gray gradient, scenery or props behind them. Consistent neutral soft frontal studio key plus subtle modeling fill, clean whites, no warm color cast. Portrait 3:4 composition, chest-up, camera at eye level, entire hairstyle and any head accessory inside frame with white margin, face mostly frontal, shoulders visible, no hands in frame. Single person only. No text, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no signature, no border. References are inspiration ONLY: design a distinct new identity, significantly redesign facial proportions, eye shape, nose, jaw, hairstyle details, jewelry and costume while retaining the broad temperament and palette. Do not merely retouch or reproduce the source character. Character 06: Feminine athletic expedition guide. Dark sandy blond layered shoulder-length shag with swept side part, golden olive eyes, firm softly squared jaw, straight brows, warm ivory skin. Dark olive field jacket over black modest crewneck, understated woven backpack straps, original generic buckles, no weapon or text. Determined but friendly expression. Input image 1 is the source mood reference ONLY: invent a clearly different person as described. Input image 2 is the RENDERING STYLE ANCHOR ONLY: match its 3D surface quality, refined facial sculpting, soft neutral white lighting and portrait crop. DO NOT copy the style anchor's identity, hair, clothes, jewelry or fantasy genre. Follow this character's specified genre and wardrobe. Retain a distinct original identity, no recycled same-face cast.

Background revision: Edit this existing portrait ONLY to replace the transparent background with a completely SOLID PURE WHITE RGB(255,255,255) opaque studio backdrop. This is a white-background JPEG-style portrait print, NOT a transparent PNG cutout or asset. Fill every transparent region and every edge background pixel with opaque pure white. Keep the character, all facial features, hairstyle, expression, clothes, colors, scale and crop exactly unchanged. No redesign, no new details, no text. Output must have a visibly white rectangular full-canvas background with 100% opacity everywhere, no alpha transparency anywhere. Preserve complete shoulders/clothing to the bottom edge, no fading floating bust.
